growlithe-fire-fang.name: Fire Fang
growlithe-fire-fang.description: Bond skill: bites with flame-wrapped fangs (Power 85, Attack), Burning the foe for 2 turns.

growlithe-extreme-speed.name: Extreme Speed
growlithe-extreme-speed.description: Bond skill: a blindingly fast rush (Power 70, Attack).

growlithe-morning-sun.name: Morning Sun
growlithe-morning-sun.description: Bond skill: basks in warm light and heals itself for 40 HP.

growlithe-loyal-guard.name: Loyal Guard
growlithe-loyal-guard.description: Foes engaged with it take 10% more damage from its allies.

growlithe-eager-pup.name: Eager Pup
growlithe-eager-pup.description: Deals 15% more damage to foes at full HP.

growlithe-howl.name: Howl
growlithe-howl.description: New skill: a rallying howl makes it and adjacent allies Focused for 1 turn.

growlithe-flame-wheel.name: Flame Wheel
growlithe-flame-wheel.description: New skill: charges wrapped in fire (Power 55), Burning the foe for 1 turn.

growlithe-flash-fire.name: Flash Fire
growlithe-flash-fire.description: Immune to Burn; its Fire-type moves deal 10% more damage.

growlithe-thick-coat.name: Thick Coat
growlithe-thick-coat.description: Its shaggy mane softens blows: takes 10% less damage.

growlithe-crunch.name: Crunch
growlithe-crunch.description: New skill: bites down hard (Power 70), leaving the foe Exposed for 1 turn.

growlithe-roar.name: Roar
growlithe-roar.description: New skill: a mighty roar drives an adjacent foe 2 hexes back.

growlithe-loyal-heart.name: Loyal Heart
growlithe-loyal-heart.description: When it faints, the team gains 2 Bond.

growlithe-hounds-pursuit.name: Hound's Pursuit
growlithe-hounds-pursuit.description: Foes engaged with it always draw its free strike when leaving, even if nimble.

growlithe-flare-blitz.name: Flare Blitz
growlithe-flare-blitz.description: New skill: cloaked in fire, it charges into a foe (Power 90).

growlithe-body-slam.name: Body Slam
growlithe-body-slam.description: New skill: pounces with its full weight (Power 85), Paralyzing the foe for 1 turn.

growlithe-agile-bound.name: Agile Bound
growlithe-agile-bound.description: Bounds away from engaged foes without drawing free strikes; deals 15% more to adjacent foes.

growlithe-unshakeable-loyalty.name: Unshakeable Loyalty
growlithe-unshakeable-loyalty.description: Survives one knockout blow per battle at 1 HP.

growlithe-thrash.name: Thrash
growlithe-thrash.description: New skill: thrashes wildly at a foe (Power 95).

growlithe-raging-fury.name: Raging Fury
growlithe-raging-fury.description: New skill: a furious fiery rampage at an adjacent foe (Power 90) that Burns it for 2 turns.

growlithe-legendary-pride.name: Legendary Pride
growlithe-legendary-pride.description: Gains 1 Attack for the battle (up to +3) whenever it knocks out a foe.

growlithe-pack-bond.name: Pack Bond
growlithe-pack-bond.description: Gives the team 1 Bond whenever it lands a combo.

growlithe-legendary-pokemon.name: Legendary Pokémon
growlithe-legendary-pokemon.description: Capstone. Heals 10% of its max HP on each knockout; deals 20% more damage while below half HP.

growlithe-thousand-mile-run.name: Thousand-Mile Run
growlithe-thousand-mile-run.description: Capstone. A knockout on its turn resets its skill cooldowns and gives back 2 movement.
